## Why it was silent

The game ships a working emitter for all six events. Each one's cooldown in the event table was set to FLT_MAX, which the engine reads as 'never replay this' — so the emitter fired and the line was silently dropped. Setting the cooldown to a real number is the entire fix. 15.0 s is not invented: it is the cooldown the game itself gives the AI counterparts of these same events (AIHit01/02/07/08, eids 220-223).

## Rebuild

```bash
C:\msys64\mingw32\bin\gcc.exe -shared -O2 -Wall \
    -o player_damage_commentary.dll player_damage_commentary.c -lkernel32
```

`source.c` writes the same bytes the manifest would write to the .exe,
but into the running process at DLL attach — so no game file is
modified and not loading the DLL is the uninstall. Each site verifies
its expected original bytes first and skips on mismatch, so a different
game build is a no-op rather than a corruption.
